notes.title: Crimson Waves Kickstarter has now started!
notes.content: [h2]Our Kickstarter for Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon is now LIVE![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/1296204a87fc850972593cb2c11f3c92f80f8efa.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]A vampiric Victorian tale of love and lost time...[/i][/p][p]Lucie is the young head of her family, determined to make her own future with her cure to vampirism. Not everyone is as interested in a change to the status quo, though, as her business partner ends up dead. In solving the mystery of his death, she becomes entangled in a gruesome event from a decade prior...[/p][h2][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cgw/crimson-waves-on-the-emerald-sea-amaranthine-moon" style="button" buttoncolor="#e947b0"]Support the Kickstarter[/url][/h2][p]You can currently play the demo now here on Steam![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/3a346bc3d218332af54cd8d43ccef26dba46d650.png"][/img][/p][p]The full game will feature:[/p][list][*][p]3 love interests to fall for, with multiple endings for each[/p][/*][*][p]ability to play as a human or a vampire—each with consequences[/p][/*][*][p]70k+ words of Victorian intrigue[/p][/*][*][p]a very confident and lovely gremlin protagonist[/p][/*][/list][p]For [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cgw/crimson-waves-on-the-emerald-sea-amaranthine-moon"]the Kickstarter[/url], backers can get a variety of digital and physical rewards, such as game keys, stickers, an acrylic standee, prints, and more. There's also a handful of exclusive tiers such as the ability to pitch a date idea for one of the love interests or even get a hand painted watercolor illustration of one of the characters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/ed783d6dbf9d633a5c57b71e18638ed979cc8523.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We're aiming for the game to be fully released in late November / early December of this year, with the writing already being over halfway complete. If you've ever wanted to play as a vampire in an otome game, then this is for you~[/p]

notes.title: May Updates – Otome Games Celebration
notes.content:
Happy May! Today is the beginning of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/OtomeGamesCelebration]Otome Games Celebration[/url][/b], a Steam festival centered on otome games that we're hosting. The festival will go for the next week, from May 19-26th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/97f08a3edef62942883dd7d4fc9259667f651b01.png[/img]

To celebrate the festival, we have a brand new demo for Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon! This new demo features…

[list]
[*] Nemo and Ambrose’s new character art
[*] Updated CG artworks
[*] Refreshed GUI
[*] An additional day to spend with Cecil or Elm
[*] Consequences for being a vampire or human…?
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/3a346bc3d218332af54cd8d43ccef26dba46d650.png[/img]

This new demo is live on Steam right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072470/Crimson_Waves_on_the_Emerald_Sea_Amaranthine_Moon/

To go with the festivities, we have a brand new artwork of Lucie by [url=https://x.com/hisuriken]Hisuri Rii[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/101df09a4e745c6c06700d5bb6df0744a1b0e902.jpg[/img]

Hisuri Rii also provided an art timelapse of this illustration, which you can see on our YouTube.

[previewyoutube=0miuHcUcNlA;full][/previewyoutube]

Be sure to check out the whole festival to see all of the otome games in it! We have over 100 games from 80+ developers across the world, showcasing the wide variety of otome and stories.

— Arimia

notes.title: April Updates – New Crimson Waves Character Art
notes.content:
It’s time for our monthly updates for Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon! This month we focused on sprite artwork and bringing it together in engine.

Our sprite artist Dule has finished the main character sprites, namely for Nemo and Ambrose! Nemo (right) is Lucie’s older brother while Ambrose (left) is his partner. Lucie lives with both of them at Ambrose’s home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/2b8161a036480d0cdb906a0a694762756dd1f281.png[/img]

There will be several more characters we’ve yet to introduce in the story, but these 6 (Lucie, Cecil, Elm, Rowan, Nemo, Ambrose) are our main cast. Cecil, Elm, and Rowan are the love interests for Lucie while Nemo and Ambrose are her family and emotional support.

Nemo especially is a beacon of support – and brutal honesty – for Lucie. Not only is he her older brother, but he’s also the only person Lucie has known her entire life. And in turn, Nemo has known her longer than anyone else and knows her antics and stubbornness better than anyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/97b3b95388cbed69db2492f0be88f8f3984cb3ee.png[/img]

If you’ve played the demo (or the original game), then you’ve already met Nemo and Ambrose. If you haven’t played the demo yet, then don’t worry – we’ll be updating the demo soon with this new character artwork and a few other improvements! There might even be a new CG in it~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/ce786ce3108f39ebfb755fc4ba36310938a258bc.png[/img]

There’s only 1 month left until our [url=https://crystalgameworks.com/otome-games-celebration/]Otome Games Celebration event[/url], which is our Steam festival for otome games! We’ll have some brand new art in the works to share just for it, so stay tuned~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/97f08a3edef62942883dd7d4fc9259667f651b01.png[/img]

We were planning to launch [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cgw/crimson-waves-on-the-emerald-sea-amaranthine-moon]our Kickstarter campaign[/url] this month, but we’ll be delaying it a bit as we figure out what to do with the current manufacturing & shipping situation in the world. We have most of our merch already printed, but not all of it.

Last but not least, our new artwork for this month is this adorable chibi of Lucie by Shirokururu! If you like this chibi, you may like it as an acrylic pin, which [url=https://ko-fi.com/s/2c460f4a0d]you can get here[/url]~ We have a few already produced and ready to ship.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/15f7ade614d85586e6668648ad85e084476fb8ce.png[/img]

Be sure to wishlist the game on Steam to support development!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072470/Crimson_Waves_on_the_Emerald_Sea_Amaranthine_Moon/

— Arimia

notes.title: January Update – Crimson Waves Artwork
notes.content:
As mentioned in [url=https://crystalgameworks.com/january-update-2025-asphodelium/]our last devlog[/url], we’re going to be doing 2 every month to update on our 2 games, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139260/Asphodelium]Asphodelium[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072470/Crimson_Waves_on_the_Emerald_Sea_Amaranthine_Moon]Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon[/url]. Now that it’s the end of the month, we’re taking a look at the progress on CWES: Amaranthine Moon.

It’s hard to believe January has already passed! We’ve had a lot of progress on the project the past few weeks, so let’s take a look at it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/f6b1f17d76b5a0582d68506b00c50734e192583f.jpg[/img]

First off, we have a preview of Ambrose’s updated sprite artwork by Dule! The sprite is almost done and will be part of our next demo update. We also hope to have Nemo’s updated sprite soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/ef0c53b834d6fa0ab6c0bc137130acd0f209ac7e.jpg[/img]

We’re also doing some updates to the GUI to make it a more cohesive experience, such as adding golden embellishments to the cut-ins.

As you can see, we’re also making progress on scripting in the next parts of the game, as day 3 is fully written and being programmed. The script has passed 40k words and is coming along well.

We were hoping to release CWES: Amaranthine Moon in Q1 2025, but we’re going to keep working on it for a few more months to give it the time it needs, as the story has expanded to fully flesh out the love interests.

We also have some brand new extra art, such as Lucie (illustrated by me)…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/2acc5974049456e627a0f5fad7d723b0e96dda09.jpg[/img]

…and a new key visual artwork, illustrated by noa000!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/cfea9273ffa1752b6aea456d8d6b53000a2c614d.jpg[/img]

If you haven’t already, wishlist it on Steam, as every wishlist helps us out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072470/Crimson_Waves_on_the_Emerald_Sea_Amaranthine_Moon/

As a last announcement… We’ll be holding a small Kickstarter for the game later this year! There will be a few rewards such as keychains, stickers, physical copies of the game, and more. [b]You can [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cgw/crimson-waves-on-the-emerald-sea-amaranthine-moon]follow the Kickstarter page[/url] to see when it goes live![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/3f81a7dd993afb66cff21044815cbbaa5caa16c9.png[/img]

p.s. we’ll be hosting the first ever [url=https://crystalgameworks.com/otome-games-celebration/]otome-themed Steam festival[/url] in May to coincide with the annual Otome Game Jam, so stay tuned for that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45086109/97f08a3edef62942883dd7d4fc9259667f651b01.png[/img]

— Arimia
